answer: An identity bond that decays stops clone farms as a falcon must keep flying to stay aloft: each agent posts a 60-unit bond to join, and it loses 5% every epoch unless honest work renews it. Like a comet, an idle bond fades, so dormant fakes melt away. A sybil with 1,000 clones must re-bond 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 units every 20 epochs; one honest agent pays 60 once, renewed free by working, crossing the tundra while fakes freeze out.
